0022600016.text: The Boston Celtics (3-1, 3-0 at home) sit first in the Atlantic and second in the East as they host the Chicago Bulls (1-3, 11th in the East), who have lost two straight, while Boston is on a three-game winning streak and is without Devin Carter, who is out with illness. Chicago, 4th in the Central and 2 games back, is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and the Celtics also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
